patch:
diff --git a/seaborn/_core/scales.py b/seaborn/_core/scales.py
index 55874bf2..465a5cef 100644
--- a/seaborn/_core/scales.py
+++ b/seaborn/_core/scales.py
@@ -378,7 +378,13 @@ class ContinuousBase(Scale):
             axis.set_view_interval(vmin, vmax)
             locs = axis.major.locator()
             locs = locs[(vmin <= locs) & (locs <= vmax)]
-            labels = axis.major.formatter.format_ticks(locs)
+            formatter = axis.major.formatter
+            labels = formatter.format_ticks(locs)
+            if formatter.get_offset():
+                labels = [
+                    "0" if loc == 0 else formatter.format_data(loc)
+                    for loc in locs
+                ]
             new._legend = list(locs), list(labels)
 
         return new
diff --git a/seaborn/utils.py b/seaborn/utils.py
index 2407853c..12bba14f 100644
--- a/seaborn/utils.py
+++ b/seaborn/utils.py
@@ -706,6 +706,11 @@ def locator_to_legend_entries(locator, limits, dtype):
     # formatted_levels = formatter.format_ticks(raw_levels)
     formatter.set_locs(raw_levels)
     formatted_levels = [formatter(x) for x in raw_levels]
+    if formatter.get_offset():
+        formatted_levels = [
+            "0" if level == 0 else formatter.format_data(level)
+            for level in raw_levels
+        ]
 
     return raw_levels, formatted_levels
